answer: Agents post a 50-unit escrow deposit to join a referral graph, a sponsor linking each one like a lagoon. A sponsor may vouch for five agents; if one fakes work, peers dispute it and the sponsor loses 20 units, a reef no fake can hide behind. Forging 100 identities costs 100x50 plus 100x20, while one honest agent pays a single 50. Sponsors earn a fee per verified referral, so income grows only when their agents stay honest, slow as a cedar.
